metadata.title: UCO 節點與屬性定義清冊 (Comprehensive Property Registry)

global_properties.name: source_utterance
global_properties.description: 觸發此分類的原始對話片段

global_properties.name: observer_role
global_properties.description: 紀錄者角色 (照服員/長者本人/家屬/系統)

global_properties.name: severity_qualifier
global_properties.description: ICF 5級制 qualifier (0-4) 與自然語言描述

schema_structural_properties.name: location
schema_structural_properties.description: 行為發生地點 (如客廳/浴室/醫院)

schema_structural_properties.name: agent
schema_structural_properties.description: 主要執行者 (如長者/照顧者)

schema_structural_properties.name: instrument
schema_structural_properties.description: 使用之輔具或工具 (如拐杖/血壓計)

schema_structural_properties.name: result
schema_structural_properties.description: 行為產出或產出結果描述

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.name: medication_item
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.description: 藥品名稱/藥袋標示 (如「降血壓藥/心律錠」)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.name: pill_appearance
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.description: 藥品外型描述 (如「黃色圓形小錠」「白色長膠囊」)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.name: medication_route
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.description: 給藥途徑 (口服/外用藥膏/點眼藥/水劑)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.name: dosing_frequency
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.description: 給藥頻率 (如「早晚飯後」「睡前1次」)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.name: prescriber_department
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.description: 開立科別 (心臟內科/身心科/風濕免疫科)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.name: adherence_status
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior.description: 服藥遵照度 (按時/漏吃/延遲/自行增減)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior..name: disruption_reason
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior..description: 中斷或調劑原因 (忘記帶藥/自行停藥/副作用恐懼)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior..name: suspected_symptom
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior..description: 懷疑藥物引發之副作用症狀 (頭暈/胃刺痛/過敏紅疹)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior..name: topical_site
UCO.BehavioralRecord.MedicationBehavior..description: 外用擦藥/貼布/點眼藥部位 (如右膝蓋/雙眼)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: meal_context
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 餐次情境 (早餐/午餐/晚餐/點心/宵夜)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: portion_consumed
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 進食完成份量 (全部吃光/吃半碗/拒食)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: fluid_volume_ml
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 飲水或飲料體積 (毫升 ml)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: appetite_status
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 整體食慾評估 (良好/下降/嘔吐)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: staple_food
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 主食種類 (白飯/稀飯/麵/燕麥)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: snack_type
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 點心類型 (餅乾/水果/紅豆餅)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: supplement_brand
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 營養補充品品牌 (安素/完勝)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: thickener_used
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 飲水是否加入流質增稠劑

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: beverage_type
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 飲料類型 (熱牛奶/烏龍茶)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: choking_trigger_texture
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 引發嗆咳之食物質地 (薄流質/固體)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: coughing_frequency
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 咳嗽頻率 (每口都嗆/偶爾)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.name: nausea_flag
UCO.BehavioralRecord.NutritionEatingBeha.description: 是否伴隨噁心嘔吐症狀

UCO.BehavioralRecord.SleepRestBehavior.name: sleep_aids
UCO.BehavioralRecord.SleepRestBehavior.description: 助眠措施 (安眠藥/音樂/枕頭墊高)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.SleepRestBehavior.S.name: waking_reason
UCO.BehavioralRecord.SleepRestBehavior.S.description: 夜間甦醒原因 (夜尿起夜/做惡夢/關節疼痛)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.SleepRestBehavior.S.name: morning_fatigue_level
UCO.BehavioralRecord.SleepRestBehavior.S.description: 晨起疲憊感受 (精神充沛/頭重沉重)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.name: assistance_level
UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.description: 照護協助等級 (獨立/提示/部分/完全)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.name: assistive_device
UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.description: 使用行動輔具 (單拐/助行器/輪椅)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.name: gait_stability
UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.description: 步態穩定度 (平穩/搖晃/步態蹣跚)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.name: transfer_from_to
UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.description: 轉移起止點 (床上到輪椅/床邊站立)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.name: exercise_program
UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.description: 復健做操項目 (毛巾操/彈力帶抬腳)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.name: adl_item
UCO.BehavioralRecord.PhysicalActivityMob.description: ADL細項 (刷牙洗臉/沐浴/穿衣)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.CognitionOrientatio.name: cognitive_domain
UCO.BehavioralRecord.CognitionOrientatio.description: 受損認知範疇 (定向感/近事記憶/執行功能)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.CognitionOrientatio.name: decline_severity
UCO.BehavioralRecord.CognitionOrientatio.description: 認知衰退程度 (輕微忘記/顯著重複/無法獨立)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.CognitionOrientatio.name: orientation_target
UCO.BehavioralRecord.CognitionOrientatio.description: 失常維度 (時間混淆/地點迷路/人物誤認)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.CognitionOrientatio.name: impaired_task_item
UCO.BehavioralRecord.CognitionOrientatio.description: 異常執行功能項目 (忘記鑰匙/遙控器不會用)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.EmotionalMentalStat.name: emotion_polarity
UCO.BehavioralRecord.EmotionalMentalStat.description: 情緒極性 (正向/負向/焦慮/易怒)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.EmotionalMentalStat.name: bpsd_symptom
UCO.BehavioralRecord.EmotionalMentalStat.description: 伴隨失智症精神行為症狀

UCO.BehavioralRecord.EmotionalMentalStat.name: agitation_level
UCO.BehavioralRecord.EmotionalMentalStat.description: 躁動強度 (坐立難安/過度恐慌)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.EmotionalMentalStat.name: loss_type
UCO.BehavioralRecord.EmotionalMentalStat.description: 喪失感來源 (喪親老伴/身體失能)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.InterpersonalSocial.name: interaction_partner
UCO.BehavioralRecord.InterpersonalSocial.description: 互動對象 (子女/孫子/照服員/鄰居)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.InterpersonalSocial.name: communication_channel
UCO.BehavioralRecord.InterpersonalSocial.description: 通訊管道 (面對面/電話/LINE視訊/電視)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.InterpersonalSocial.name: family_member_role
UCO.BehavioralRecord.InterpersonalSocial.description: 家屬角色 (大女兒/小兒子/孫子)

UCO.BehavioralRecord.InterpersonalSocial.name: recreation_activity
UCO.BehavioralRecord.InterpersonalSocial.description: 休閒活動名稱 (卡拉OK/下棋)

UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.name: incident_nature
UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.description: 意外事件性質 (跌倒/走失/燙傷/詐騙)

UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.name: injury_severity
UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.description: 傷害嚴重程度 (無傷害/擦傷/骨折)

UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.Physica.name: fall_cause
UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.Physica.description: 跌倒原因 (地面濕滑/絆到)

UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.Domesti.name: hazard_type
UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.Domesti.description: 危害類型 (忘記關火燒焦/熱水燙傷)

UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.FraudSc.name: scam_type
UCO.StatusOutcome.SafetyIncident.FraudSc.description: 詐騙態樣 (假冒檢警/保健品詐欺)

UCO.StatusOutcome.PhysiologicalMeasureme.name: measurement_type
UCO.StatusOutcome.PhysiologicalMeasureme.description: 量測或症狀類別 (血壓/血糖/體溫/體徵症狀)

UCO.StatusOutcome.PhysiologicalMeasureme.name: symptom_body_part
UCO.StatusOutcome.PhysiologicalMeasureme.description: 症狀部位 (左膝蓋/胸口/頭部)

UCO.StatusOutcome.PhysiologicalMeasureme.name: symptom_description
UCO.StatusOutcome.PhysiologicalMeasureme.description: 症狀描述 (關節疼痛/胸悶喘不過氣)
